args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Upgrading within the 2.x line to 2.9.4, which contains the fix.

args.head: fix/cve-2026-31337-fastjson-upgrade
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fix CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
payments-service pins fastjson 2.8.0, which is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

## Change
- Upgraded `fastjson` in `requirements.txt` from **2.8.0 → 2.9.4**, staying within the 2.x line for a minimal-risk fix. 2.9.4 is listed as a fixed version in the advisory.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/cve-2026-31337-fastjson-upgrade` (sha c8b8ab7878): **passed**

Review requested from @alex.
